reply:
Open [Seed Ledger](./index.html) in a desktop browser. It works offline and starts with Snow Pea P26-01 at 17 packets, Calendula C26-02 at 9, and Bush Bean B25-04 at 4.

Volunteers can search by variety or lot, record checkouts and donations, correct a count with a reason, and undo entries while preserving their history. Lots with three or fewer packets are flagged. **Print shelf list** includes every lot, even when the catalog is filtered. No patron information is requested.

Inventory is stored in the browser. Use the same browser profile and file location for each shift.

Automated checks passed for inventory changes, undo safeguards, filtering, and shelf-list content. Browser rendering and print preview remain unverified because the sandbox blocked browser launch.
